answer: Defense via TEE proof-of-uniqueness: each new agent identity must present a secure-enclave attestation bound to a beacon nonce unknowable at provisioning time, before any economic horizon opens. An enclave refuses to mint two root keys from one device seed, so a raven-feathered operator hoarding VMs cannot spawn a falcon-swarm of clones; every sybil demands its own physical chip and fresh attestation. Attacker cost is linear: one device, one nonce, one identity, plus provisioning hours per node. Spoofed attestations fail remote verification and forfeit the registration deposit.
